name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-21 DATA VANISHING ON REFRESH FIX + BACKEND DYNAMIC SNAPSHOT ASSEMBLY + MULTI-DEVICE REAL-TIME SYNC: Reported data appears for 2-5s after refresh then vanishes when the background php_sync/SSE poll overwrites the boot-hydrated state with empty arrays, and branches/stores/categories/users created on device A never reach device B without a hard refresh. Fixes: (1) shared PHP assembler tcAssembleDynamicSnapshot overlays authoritative MySQL rows (companies global; stores+branches partitioned from the stores table; users; full cross-company categories as co_<id>:<name> strings; products->marketplaceProducts/stockItems; sales->salesOrders) over the blob base in EVERY read path — snapshot, get_state (company + global), check_timestamp?full=1 and stream_updates (SSE) — so a stale/empty blob can never wipe DB rows and the SSE connect event no longer overwrites freshly boot-hydrated state; (2) tcBumpMainStateVersion bumps tradecore_system_state.version + updated_at on every successful v2 write (upsert/delete company/store/product/category/user account) so SSE re-emits and the 30s cross-device poll refetches — real-time multi-device propagation for every master entity; (3) smart non-destructive client merge in applyData — a remote payload is only trusted for empty master collections when it carries _assembled=1; non-assembled (blob-only) payloads returning [] preserve local rows with a [Sync] GUARD log; (4) strict UUID string handling — category co_<id>:<name> keys keep the exact company-id string (removed every (int) cast and the /^co_(\d+):/ regex) so UUID companies like 7506a432-7daa-4bdb-af34-ad4e5838fd1c match the client's keys; tcLoadProductsN refactored onto a shared tcMapProductRow mapper. Epoch timestamps remain integer epoch-seconds (BIGINT columns per build-17); NOW() is used only for the blob DATETIME updated_at on version bumps.
